raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 payments-source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records (orig_txn_id points to the original), and the original stays POSTED. silver_transactions keeps only status='POSTED', so reversed originals are still counted and gold totals run high. The fix is to drop POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL record; this assumes reversals are full reversals of the original amount, which the sample rows do not confirm.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions v WHERE v.status = 'REVERSAL' AND v.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id);"}}
